items.a: Arnav Khandelwal builds backend applications and AI-enabled systems in Python and Java while studying Electrical Engineering at MNIT Jaipur. His public work includes offline LLM services, cited research agents and deterministic reconciliation. Each case study separates repository evidence from unverified claims and explains the limits of its results.

items.q: How are the project results verified?
items.a: Project results link to public repository documentation or committed benchmark reports. The portfolio preserves sample sizes, approximate timings and hardware limitations rather than presenting every number as a universal result. Résumé-only performance claims remain hidden until public evidence is available, and documented test counts are distinguished from fresh test execution.
